# Emlet

> Emlet is an AI email generator: describe a marketing campaign in plain English and get a fully designed, brand-matched, production-ready HTML email in seconds — no design or coding skills required.

Emlet writes the copy, builds the layout, and applies your brand colors, voice, and logo automatically. Every email is editable in a visual block-based editor and exports as clean HTML or React (TSX) for any ESP (Mailchimp, SendGrid, Resend, and others).
